hisense_connectlife.title: Sign in to ConnectLife
hisense_connectlife.description: Use the account you use in the ConnectLife app. Google, Apple and email sign-in all work.

menu_options.hisense_paste: Sign in, then paste the address

hisense_paste.title: Paste the sign-in address
hisense_paste.description:
1. Open [this ConnectLife sign-in page]({url}) and sign in.
2. Your browser then opens an address starting with {redirect}. That page may fail to load, which is fine.
3. Copy the full address from the address bar and paste it below.

demo.title: Demo ducted unit
demo.description: A simulated unit with rooms that warm and cool, for trying zones and dashboards without hardware.

zones.title: Zones on {unit}
zones.description: The controller has {slots} zone slots. Zones that look installed: {detected}. Enter how many zones your system uses; they are numbered from 1, as in the ConnectLife app.

zone_names.title: Name your zones
zone_names.description: Use the same names as the ConnectLife app so they are easy to match. You can rename zones and set their areas later.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your ConnectLife sign-in has expired. Sign in again to keep controlling your system.

error.invalid_redirect_url: That address has no sign-in code. Copy the whole address from the browser after signing in.
error.oauth_failed: ConnectLife did not accept the sign-in code. Sign in again and paste the new address straight away.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. Cyborg HVAC is reconnecting.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach ConnectLife. Check your internet connection and try again.
abort.no_units: This account has no supported air conditioners.
abort.account_accept_terms: ConnectLife needs you to accept updated terms. Open the ConnectLife app, accept them, then try again.

data_description.comfort_offset: Shifts this room's comfort range, for example 1 degree cooler for a bedroom.
data_description.guest_zone: Guest mode gives this zone priority. Use it for living and dining areas.
data_description.spill: May be opened to keep enough airflow when other zones close.
data_description.min_opening: The smallest opening smart comfort will set while this zone is on.

account_accept_terms.title: Accept the new ConnectLife terms
account_accept_terms.description: ConnectLife has paused access until you accept updated terms. Open the ConnectLife app, accept them, and Cyborg HVAC reconnects on its own.

inputs.title: House sensors and weather
inputs.description: Smart comfort uses these to give advice. Leave out anything you do not have.

data_description.solar_grid_sensor: Used to spot spare solar. Most inverters report export as negative grid power.

comfort.title: Comfort targets
comfort.description: Below the heating target a room is too cold; above the cooling target it is too warm. In between is comfortable.

error.band_order: Each heating target must be below its cooling target.
